title: Value v belongs at index v − 1: keep swapping nums[i] home until the right value sits at i
caption: Values 1..n in an array of length n. i stays put while it swaps; each swap places at least one value for good.

frames.text: i = 0: nums[0] = 3 belongs at index 2. Swap it home.
3 is home now. The value that landed at i is 5, which belongs at index 4. i doesn't move: swap again.
5 is home. Now 2 is at i = 0, and it belongs at index 1. Swap.
1 is at index 0, so it's home and i moves on. 2, 3, 4 and 5 are already home: done after 3 swaps, O(n) time and O(1) space.
